questions.question:
Which option represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in English dictionary?

1) Persecute

2) Personal

3) Persistent

4) Performance

5) Perfection
questions.solution:
Correct order of appearance in English dictionary:

From left to right,

5. Per**__fe__**ction 4. Per**__fo__**rmance 1. Per**__se__**cute 3. Per**__si__**stent 2. Per**__so__**nal

Hence, correct order is 5, 4, 1, 3, 2.

Hence, option 1 is correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All insects are birds.

All reptiles are birds.

No crab is bird.

**Conclusions:**

I. No insect is reptile.

II. Some insects are reptile.

III. No crab is reptile.

options.text: Only Conclusion I and either II or III follows.
Only Conclusion I and II follow.
Only Conclusion II and III follows.
Only Conclusion III and either I or II follows.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1204ec259448611bd1fcb391a07d8625cada52a1278b35de764c0046738873c7.png] 

Conclusion 1: No insect is reptile → False (It is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 2: Some insects are reptile → False (It is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 3: No crab is reptile → True

Hence, ‘Only conclusion III follows and either I or II follows’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A & B means ‘A is mother of B’

A % B means ‘A is daughter of B’

A # B means ‘A is sister of B’

A $ B means ‘A is son of B’

If U & T & K # C % Z $ S, then how is T related to S?
questions.solution:
Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
%

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
$

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 

 
 
Of B

 
 
 

 

Now draw a family tree using the following notations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d4fe71c914c9d6679571ced7973c8b59dbc35a485d556af7798361d63c3ba38.png] 

U & T & K # C % Z $ S means ‘U is mother of T, T is mother K, K is sister of C, C is daughter of Z, Z is son of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/457ca6971c8d3e10883e39db71db851b7effeba326de21e16cb44151c07d7f76.png] 

So, T is S’s son’s wife.

Hence, ‘Son’s wife’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are shown in dots numbered 1 to 6. How many dots will be on the opposite to the face showing ‘3 dots’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51f7013dd4c05e59be0249e67a5f4db2d48dc25f75e56d4c6a353b672d28d631.png]
questions.solution:
From dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbc09bef024cf3892b55055d720932ae40536b24163caa6a2a7e6a8df72dd4b8.png] 

We can deduce that,

6 dots, 3 dots, 4 dots and 2 dots cannot be opposite to 5 dots. Therefore, 1 dot must be opposite to 5 dots.

From dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e8080fc3365c02aa0fe925ace4a0468060502360420e81ae0b34281c7417d90.png] 

We can deduce that,

Neither 2 dots nor 6 dots are opposite to 4 dots. Therefore, 3 dots must be opposite to 4 dots.

Hence, ‘4’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a code language, if ‘PLAYER’ is coded as ‘119’, then how will ‘OPTIONS’ be coded in the same language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfbcbe8b4268b7a4ecc25f983b74ec52036d0524e85c60be9e915dc19a6ce26f.png] 

The pattern followed is,

PLAYER:

P + L + A + Y + E + R → 16 + 12 + 1 + 25 + 5 + 18 = 77

So, 77 + 42 = 119

Similarly,

OPTIONS:

O + P + T + I + O + N + S →15 + 16 + 20 + 9 + 15 + 14 + 19 = 108

So, 108 + 42 = 150

Hence, ‘150’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

K _ CT _ BLUC _ M _ M _ C _ MB
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here,

K | __U__ C | T __M__ B | L | U C | __T__ M __B__ | M | __U__ C | __T__ M B

The alphabets K, L and M are increasing alphabetical order while UC and TMB remain constant.

Hence, ‘UMTBUT’ is the correct answer.
